cards.the commander: a tall woman in a black floor-length robe with subtly woven gold patterns, a narrow crimson lining along the front and hem, gold shoulder pieces, black leather gloves, and black boots; her straight black hair is drawn into a high ponytail with a gold ornament; pale skin and a sharp profile
cards.the adjutant: a man of about twenty-six in a black military coat with dense gold embroidery across the chest and shoulders, a crimson inner lining, a long black cape, black leather gloves, and short dark hair

state_timeline.U01: the planet is still largely intact, only its near edge beginning to break apart, no glowing fissures yet
state_timeline.U05: roughly half the planet has broken away, glowing orange fissures across the broken face, the dust veil thickening
state_timeline.U08: more than half the planet is gone, the remaining shell glowing at its rim, the dust thinning
state_timeline.U12: the planet is reduced to a debris ring, its core no longer visible, the dust settled
